en:
I'd be happy with anything you
gave me, Angie.
Nyahaha, you're so sweet, Shuichi.

Then I'll give you the divine painting I drew
earlier.

<CLT=cltMIND>My consciousness faded, as if falling
off a great height, down, down...
Huh? Shuichi, are you okay?
<CLT=cltMIND>I think this conversation went well.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that she's talking
about one of her art pieces...
Ah, um. I can't accept that present...

Oh... Well, if you say so.
Maybe that's for the best.

But then...how should I get closer to you,
Shuichi?

Maybe I should've asked Atua instead of
coming up with my own idea.

<CLT=cltMIND>Oh no, I drove Angie back into
dependence on Atua...

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like that didn't
go well...
Well, perhaps you should ask Atua?
Nyahahaha! You're so divine, Shuichi!
Even Atua is amazed by your divinity!

If that's what you think I should do, then
I'll ask Him!

<CLT=cltMIND>Good, it seems like
we both had a lot of fun.

Why not think of what *you* want sometimes?
Forget about Atua.

Huh? You don't believe in Atua?
Atua's word is infallible, y'know?

N-No, that's not what I mean. I was just
trying to say that...

Hmm? I thought you were divine but
maybe I was wrong.

I need to ask Atua if you're really fit to
be my husband.
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, this is awkward...
